hints: Note that $OE \perp AB$ and bisects angle $\angle AOB = 1.8\text{ rad}$.
Use right-triangle trigonometry with hypotenuse $OA = 6$ and angle $0.9$ rad: $OE = 6\cos(0.9)$.
walkthrough:
Use the right-angled triangle $OAE$ formed by the perpendicular radius $OE$ to the tangent line $AB$:
$$\angle AOE = \frac{\angle COD}{2} = \frac{1.8}{2} = 0.9\text{ radians}$$
$$OE = OA\cos(0.9) = 6\cos(0.9)$$

Evaluate $6\cos(0.9)$ in radians to $3$ significant figures:
$$OE = 6 \times 0.62161\ldots = 3.73\text{ cm}$$

skill_tags: Finding Areas of Composite Circular Regions

hints: Calculate the major sector area with radius $6$ and angle $2\pi - 1.8$.
Calculate the minor sector area with radius $3.73$ and angle $1.8$.
Add the two sector areas together.
walkthrough:
Calculate the central angle and area of the major circular sector $OAB$ with radius $R = 6\text{ cm}$:
$$\text{Major angle } \theta = 2\pi - 1.8 \approx 4.4832\text{ radians}$$
$$\text{Area of major sector} = \frac{1}{2}(6^2)(2\pi - 1.8) = 18(2\pi - 1.8) \approx 80.70\text{ cm}^2$$

Calculate the area of the minor circular sector $OCED$ with radius $r = 3.73\text{ cm}$ and central angle $1.8\text{ radians}$:
$$\text{Area of minor sector} = \frac{1}{2}(3.7297^2)(1.8) = 0.9 \times 13.9104 \approx 12.52\text{ cm}^2$$

Sum the areas of the two sectors to find the total shaded area:
$$\text{Total Shaded Area} = 80.70 + 12.52 = 93.22 \approx 93.2\text{ cm}^2$$

ai_rubric.Circular Measure: Calculates major sector angle $2\pi - 1.8$ and area $80.70$ (M1M1). Calculates minor sector area $12.52$ (M1). Obtains total area $93.2\text{ cm}^2$ (A1).
